Working notes (ticket routing)

- Ticket format: REQ-24xx with subject = refund/shipment/claim + region + size; options A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.
- C (regional office) has been rejected in 9/9 observed attempts, across all regions (north, south, east), all request types (refund, shipment, claim), and both small and large sizes. Treat C as invalid for these tickets; do not choose regional office.
- B (priority desk) was rejected for REQ-2407: large claim, east region. So B is not valid for at least that case; priority is not a universal fix.
- A (standard queue) is the only option not yet tested in the observed tickets. For similar tickets, default next attempt to A unless new evidence rules it out.
- No successful routing has been confirmed yet. All attempts so far returned +0.00/rejected.
- Sender, requester, message urgency, “second attempt,” and mentions of regional office did not change rejection outcomes. Do not rely on those as routing signals without new evidence.
- Continue logging attempted option and rejection details; prioritize finding one successful A or B case to confirm the rule.

Working notes (ticket routing)

- Ticket format now includes invoice as well as refund/shipment/claim; fields: request type, region, size. Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.
- C (regional office): rejected in 9/9 older attempts across regions, request types, and sizes. Treat C as invalid.
- A (standard queue): confirmed valid for small refund, south region (REQ-2411–2414 all accepted). Sender, urgency, “second attempt,” and regional-office mention did not affect these successes.
- A rejected for: small invoice east (2410), small claim north (2415–2416), small shipment south (2417), large invoice east (2418), small claim south (2419). So A is not a default for non-refund cases; avoid A for observed invoice/claim/shipment combos.
- B (priority desk): only known outcome is rejection for REQ-2407 (large claim, east). B remains under-tested and is the next candidate when A is ruled out.
- No universal option is confirmed. Routing likely depends on request type/region/size, not sender, requester, urgency, “second attempt,” or regional-office wording.
- Next tests: prioritize B on invoice, shipment, claim, and refunds outside the confirmed small-south case. Log type, region, size, option, and outcome. Continue avoiding C.

Working notes (ticket routing)

- Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office. Fields: request type, region, size.
- C: rejected 9/9 older attempts; still treat as invalid. Avoid.
- A: accepted only small refunds, south region (REQ-2411–2414). Rejected for small invoice east, large invoice east, small claim north, small claim south, small shipment south. Not a safe default for non-refund cases.
- B: now well tested.
  - Shipment: accepted all B tests: large/small north (2422,2426,2427), small east (2428). B is valid/candidate for shipment; south still untested.
  - Claim: accepted large claim north (2421); rejected large claim east (2407), small claim south (2425). B valid for large claim north; other claim combos unclear.
  - Refund: rejected all B refund tests: large north (2420), large south (2423,2424), small north (2429). Avoid B for refunds.
  - Invoice: B untested; try B next.
- Sender/requester, urgency, “second attempt,” and regional-office wording did not affect outcomes.
- No universal option. Routing likely depends on type, region, and size.
- Next tests: A for refunds outside confirmed small-south; B for invoice; B for shipment south; resolve remaining claim combos. Log type, region, size, option, outcome. Continue avoiding C.

Working notes (ticket routing)

- Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office. D is invalid/not an option. C rejected 9/9 older; avoid.
- Routing depends on type, region, size. Sender/requester, urgency, “second attempt,” and regional-office wording did not affect outcomes. No universal option.
- A: accepted only small refunds south (REQ-2411–2414). New rejects: small refund north (2432, 2436), small refund east (2433). Also rejected small/large invoice east, small claim north/south, small shipment south. Not safe default.
- B:
  - Shipment: accepted large north (2422, 2430), small east (2428). Rejected small north (2437). South/other combos unclear. Older small-north shipment results conflict; rely on confirmed cases.
  - Claim: accepted large north (2421), small north (2435). Rejected large east (2407), small south (2425). South/large and east/small unclear.
  - Refund: rejected all B refund tests: large north (2420), large south (2423, 2424), small north (2429). Avoid B for refunds.
  - Invoice: accepted large east (2438). Small/other invoice unclear; B candidate for invoice.
- C invalid. D invalid.
- Next tests: B for invoice small/south; B for shipment south/large east; B for small claim east and large claim south; A for large refund combos if refund routing still unresolved. Continue avoiding C and D. Log type, region, size, option, outcome.

Working notes (ticket routing)

- Options: A standard, B priority, C regional. D invalid. C is not universally invalid: C accepted small claim south (2441), though older C tests mostly rejected. Use C cautiously, especially small claim south.
- Routing depends on type, region, size. Sender/requester, urgency, “second attempt,” and wording do not affect outcomes. No universal option.
- A: accepted only older small refunds south (2411–2414). New rejects: large claim east (2440, 2446), large refund east (2443). Also prior rejects across claim/invoice/shipment/refund. Not safe default.
- B:
  - Claim: accepted large north (2421), small north (2435, 2448). Rejected large east (2407), small south (2425), large south (2442).
  - Shipment: accepted large north (2422, 2430), small east (2428); rejected small north (2437), large north (2445). Large north now conflicts. South/other unclear.
  - Refund: all B refund tests rejected. Avoid B for refunds.
  - Invoice: large east accepted (2438) but later rejected (2447); small north (2444) and small south (2449) rejected. B unreliable for invoices.
- C: mostly rejected earlier; accepted small claim south (2441). Test C for other claim/south combos; do not blanket-avoid.
- Next tests: resolve B shipment large north conflict; B invoice large east conflict; C small/large claim south; A large refund combos. Log type, region, size, option, outcome.

Working notes (ticket routing)

- Options: A standard, B priority, C regional. D invalid. Routing depends on type, region, size. Sender/requester, urgency, “second attempt,” and wording do not affect outcomes. No universal option.
- A: not safe for refunds. Rejected small/large refund south (2451, 2452, 2450, 2458), small refund east (2455). Older small refund south accepts (2411–2414) no longer hold. Also rejects large claim east (2440, 2446), large refund east (2443). Accepted small invoice north (2453). Not a default.
- B: Avoid for refunds; all B refund tests rejected.
  - Claim: accepted large north (2421), small north (2435, 2448); rejected large east (2407), small south (2425), large south (2442).
  - Shipment: accepted large north (2422, 2430). Small east accepted once (2428) but now rejected (2457), so unreliable. Rejected small north (2437), large north (2445). Large north conflict remains.
  - Invoice: unreliable. Accepted large east once (2438), but large east rejected (2447, 2456), small east rejected (2454), small north (2444), small south (2449). Treat B as invalid for invoice unless new evidence.
- C: mostly rejected. Accepted only small claim south (2441). Rejected small shipment south (2459). Test C for other claim/south combos; do not blanket-avoid.

Next tests: resolve B shipment large north conflict; test C claim/south by size; test A outside small invoice north. Log type, region, size, option, outcome.
